properties.description: The Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) Drug Overdose Prevention (DOP) project. This project was designed to be a one-stop resource for individuals, families, and communities affected by drug addiction. It provides information on where to find naloxone, a medication designed to rapidly reverse opioid overdose, where to take back unused drugs, and where to find treatment services. Data will be updated as it is finalized and approved. Therefore updates will not occur on a specific schedule. Specific questions about data and resources should be directed to DHHS.PDMP@Nebraska.gov Additional information about the Nebraska Drug Overdose Prevention Program can be found by visiting: https://dhhs.ne.gov/Pages/Drug-Overdose-Prevention.aspx
properties.licenseInfo: The project is meant for public use, to provide access to data, resources, and services. Use of the data beyond and outside this application is not recommended. A best practice for resources and services would be to contact them before accessing a service.
